Guideline: Pair Reanimated withSpring + expo-haptics on Pressable
Description: Native mobile users expect synchronized visual compression and Taptic Engine feedback on key interactions.
Do: Run scale.value = withSpring(0.96) on onPressIn and Haptics.impactAsync(ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light) on activation
Don't: Use legacy TouchableOpacity which only dims opacity without physical scale or haptics
Code Good: onPressIn={() => { scale.value = withSpring(0.96, { damping: 18, stiffness: 450 }); Haptics.selectionAsync(); }}
